links.outcome: Rate of incorrect information and omissions in LLM home care instructions versus professional gold standard
links.effect: Copilot incorrect information 20% (2/10), GPT-4o 10% (1/10), GPT-3.5 0%; details omitted in 60% (6/10) of cases for GPT-4o and Copilot and 80% (8/10) for GPT-3.5; error frequency did not differ across models (P=.65).
links.quote: Furthermore, error frequency did not differ significantly across models (P=.65), though Copilot had the highest rate of incorrect information (20%, 2/10 vs 10%, 1/10 for GPT-4o and 0%, 0/0 for GPT-3.5).

screen.reason: The study evaluates the accuracy, specificity, and quality of instructions generated by several commercial LLMs across 10 home care scenarios compared to a professional gold standard, without testing specific deployment practices or guardrails.
